# assistant API

Chat control: proposals from typed requests (optional add-on, ADR 0075).

Base path `/api/v1/assistant` behind the gateway. Authentication, rate limits and the error format are the same for every service: see [Scripting MowDeck](../../guides/scripting.md). Rendered from [`apps/web/openapi/assistant.json`](https://github.com/lukislp/mowdeck/blob/main/apps/web/openapi/assistant.json) (OpenAPI 3.1), which you can also load into any OpenAPI tool.

## Operations

### assistant

#### POST /api/v1/assistant/mowers/{mower_id}/proposals

**Propose**

Interpret one request for one mower and validate the result against the mower's actions, areas and the caller's rights. Answers a proposal; nothing is executed. The text is neither stored nor logged.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [ProposalIn](#proposalin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [ProposalOut](#proposalout) |
| 404 | The mower does not exist or the caller cannot see it. | no body |
| 409 | `assistant-provider-missing`: no AI provider configured. | no body |
| 422 | Empty or too long text, or an unknown time zone. | no body |
| 429 | `assistant-limit`: the caller's or the provider's limit. | no body |
| 502 | `assistant-provider-failed`: the model gave no usable answer. | no body |
| 503 | A MowDeck service the assistant reads did not answer. | no body |

#### GET /api/v1/assistant/status

**Assistant Status**

Whether the caller can ask now: with the provider interpreter a configured AI provider (own or the installation's, Settings, AI provider) is needed; the phrase parser is always ready.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [StatusOut](#statusout) |

## Schemas

### ActionKind

What a proposal can contain.

Type: `"start_now"` \| `"start_later"` \| `"pause"` \| `"resume"` \| `"dock"`

### ActionOut

One validated action: exactly what the web app executes after the user confirmed.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `area_ids` | array of string | yes | `start_now`/`start_later`: the areas in mowing order (every area when the user named none); empty for the other kinds. |
| `areas` | array of [AreaOut](#areaout) | yes |  |
| `duration_minutes` | integer or null | yes | `start_later`: the time window. |
| `kind` | [ActionKind](#actionkind) | yes |  |
| `start_at` | string (date-time) or null | yes | `start_later`: the UTC start. |
| `start_local` | string or null | yes | `start_later`: the start as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM` in `timezone`. |
| `timezone` | string or null | yes |  |

### AreaOut

A map area of the mower.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |

### Note

Why (part of) a request has no action, as the model or the phrase parser reports it.

The web app explains each in the user's language; free text from the model is never shown (it could carry injected instructions or links).

Type: `"manual_drive"` \| `"settings"` \| `"timed_resume"` \| `"other_mower"` \| `"unsupported"` \| `"unclear"`

### ProposalIn

`POST /mowers/{mower_id}/proposals`: one request in the user's words.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes | What the user typed.; min length 1; max length 500 |
| `timezone` | string | yes | IANA time zone of the user (the browser's): times like "tomorrow 8:00" are meant in it, and a one-off start is scheduled in it.; min length 1; max length 64 |

### ProposalOut

The validated proposal for one request. Nothing has been executed.

`executable` is true only when every action passed validation (all or nothing); then the web app shows the actions on a confirmation card and, after the user confirmed, sends them through Fleet's command and the Scheduler's schedule endpoints with the user's token.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `actions` | array of [ActionOut](#actionout) | yes |  |
| `areas` | array of [AreaOut](#areaout) | yes | Every map area of the mower. |
| `created_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |
| `executable` | boolean | yes |  |
| `expires_at` | string (date-time) | yes | Execute before this time, else ask again. |
| `interpreter` | `"provider"` \| `"phrases"` | yes |  |
| `model` | string or null | yes |  |
| `mower_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `mower_name` | string | yes |  |
| `notes` | array of [Note](#note) | yes | Why (part of) the request has no action. |
| `rejected` | array of [RejectedOut](#rejectedout) | yes |  |
| `unavailable` | map of [Unavailable](#unavailable) | yes | Kinds not offered for this mower right now, with the reason. |

### RejectedOut

An action of the interpretation that the validator refused.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | [Rejection](#rejection) | yes |  |
| `kind` | [ActionKind](#actionkind) or null | yes |  |

### Rejection

Why one action of the model's answer was refused by the validator.

Type: `"unknown_kind"` \| `"not_offered"` \| `"unknown_area"` \| `"too_many_areas"` \| `"unexpected_field"` \| `"time_missing"` \| `"time_invalid"` \| `"time_past"` \| `"time_too_far"` \| `"duration_invalid"` \| `"too_many_actions"` \| `"conflict"` \| `"malformed"`

### StatusOut

`GET /status`: whether the caller can ask now.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hosted` | boolean or null | yes | The installation's model, not the caller's own. |
| `interpreter` | `"provider"` \| `"phrases"` | yes | `provider`: the caller's AI provider (Settings, AI provider); `phrases`: the built-in phrase parser without AI (demo mode or the operator's choice). |
| `model` | string or null | yes | The model a request would use (never a key). |
| `ready` | boolean | yes |  |
| `reason` | `"no_provider"` \| `"provider_unavailable"` or null | yes | Why not ready: no provider configured (own or the installation's), or the AI provider settings (Vision) are not reachable. |

### Unavailable

Why a kind is not offered for this mower right now.

Type: `"permission"` \| `"no_areas"` \| `"state"` \| `"not_connected"`
